title: FTSE Russell June 2027 reconstitution lock-down begins — the preliminary lists stop being preliminary
source: EST: rule-derived from the index owner's ground rules, with the Monday convention confirmed against all four published instances. FTSE Russell, "Russell US Equity Indexes" construction and methodology, v7.2, August 2026 (lseg.com dam PDF, HTTP 200, 746,491 bytes, text-extracted in-session 2026-09-06), Appendix F's June column: Query Period = "For two weeks following preliminary announcement", Lock down = "Three weeks after query period ends"; the same appendix's definitions state what the date means -- "During lock down, the Russell US index semi-annual reconstitution is considered final, and any additional changes are made in exceptional circumstances only, in accordance with the FTSE Russell Recalculation Policy and Guidelines". Two weeks after the 2027-05-21 preliminary announcement is Friday 2027-06-04, and the owner starts lock-down on the following MONDAY: 2023 prelim 05-19, query ends 06-02, "Lock-down period begins Monday, June 5th"; 2024 prelim 05-24, query ends 06-07, lock-down "Monday, June 10th"; 2025 prelim 05-23, query ends 06-06, lock-down "Monday 9th June"; 2026 prelim 05-22, query ends 06-05, lock-down Monday 06-08 -- each read this session off FTSE Russell's own schedule press release for that year. Four instances, four exact matches to the next-Monday rule, so 2027-06-07. Filed estimate because it rests on a rule-derived preliminary date (2027-05-21) that itself rests on a rule-derived implementation date (2027-06-25), and no FTSE Russell 2027 reconstitution calendar is published until roughly 2027-03. Promote on that published 2027 schedule naming the lock-down date. Discovered during the russell-recon-preliminary-2027-05-21 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-recon-preliminary-2027-05-21 initial research (2026-09-06). WHY IT IS A SEPARATE ENTRY: it is the date the June 2027 membership stops being an estimate. 2027-05-21 publishes a list the owner revises every Friday through the query period; 2027-06-07 is when it is "considered final". For a house whose standing rule is that estimates widen caution and never license action, the transition from revisable to final is the decision-relevant milestone of this whole chain, and it sits between the two entries that already exist (announcement 2027-05-21, implementation 2027-06-25) with neither of them able to represent it. THE PROPOSER MEASURED THE SUB-WINDOWS IT SEPARATES AND FOUND NOTHING: splitting the five-week window at lock-down across 2023-2026 gives IWM-vs-SPY -0.17% over the query period (n=4, 2 of 4 positive) and +0.80% over lock-down-to-implementation (n=4, but 1 of 4 positive -- the mean is 2026's +6.91% alone, and the median is -1.06%). At n=4 per side neither half is distinguishable from noise, and the split is filed as structure worth tracking rather than as a measured effect. Impact low, status estimate: no shares move on this date, no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (re-grepped 2026-09-06, zero hits), shorting is blocked house-wide. Kind `sector` matches the sibling market-structure flow entries; the enum has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane.
